description: Copy a shared stills template into this workspace from its link or token. The copy is a new saved template (it appears in stills_templates_list) that does not change when the original does. The layout is checked before it is saved.

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.

token.description: The token, or the whole link

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: stills_template_import
title: Import a shared stills template
